rca_of_issue: Review_request target incident 03c39871-d96c-4431-b8ed-fcf91e51d3e0 does not carry is_demo_seed=true (seeded as a real PRODUCTION report). Prompt 14 demo isolation (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md) means Demo CGM D500 can only read/mutate rows where is_demo_seed=true. Hence /api/incidents/{id} returns 404 and the detail screen enters ErrorRetry. Mitigation: either re-seed/clone the target incident with is_demo_seed=true (keeping the 2 faces + 1 plate 'MH12AB1234') or hand the agent a different, demo-seeded id with the same shape.
